title: Learn About Woot Health
tagline: Healthcare that actually works for you
introduction: Woot Health is a digital health maintenance organization (HMO) built to make healthcare simple, accessible, and stress-free. We help you get quality medical care when you need it without long processes, confusion, or unnecessary delays.

sections.heading: What We Do
sections.content: We connect you to trusted hospitals, doctors, and healthcare providers so you can focus on getting better, not figuring things out.
highlights: Manage your health plan from your phone

sections.heading: How Woot Health Works
sections.content: Woot Health simplifies healthcare by handling complex processes for you, so you can focus on getting the care you need.

steps.title: Sign Up on the App
whatYouDo: Download the Woot Health mobile app
Create an account using your phone number, email, and address
Complete basic personal details such as name, date of birth, and gender
behindTheScenes: Your profile is validated and stored
You gain access to available health plans
steps.outcome: You now have an active Woot Health account

steps.title: Choose a Health Plan
whatYouDo: Browse available health plans within the app
View coverage details, benefits, hospital access, and pricing
Select a plan that fits your healthcare needs
Proceed to pay for the selected health plan
behindTheScenes: Your selected plan is assigned to your profile
Coverage rules and benefits are activated

steps.title: Receive Your Woot Health ID
whatYouDo: View your Woot Health ID directly in the app
Save or screenshot it for offline use
behindTheScenes: A unique, secure HMO ID is generated
Your ID is linked to your health plan and profile
steps.outcome: You can now access care at Woot Health partner hospitals

steps.title: Visit a Partner Hospital
whatYouDo: Go to any Woot Health approved hospital
Present your Woot Health ID at reception
behindTheScenes: The hospital verifies your ID in the Woot Health system
Your coverage and eligibility are confirmed in real time
steps.outcome: You are checked in and cleared to receive care

steps.title: Receive Medical Care
whatYouDo: See a doctor and receive treatment as covered by your plan
behindTheScenes: Your care details are logged securely
steps.outcome: You receive treatment without unnecessary delays

steps.title: Claims and Payments
whatYouDo: Nothing extra is required from you, focus on recovery
behindTheScenes: The hospital submits claims to Woot Health
Claims are reviewed, validated, and paid
Any follow-up is handled directly with the provider
steps.outcome: You enjoy a smooth, cashless healthcare experience

sections.heading: Why Choose Woot Health
highlights: Simple and digital health management through the mobile app
Trusted hospitals within a growing verified provider network
Transparent care with clear plans and no hidden surprises

subsections.title: Manage Your Health from One Place
points: View your health plan and benefits
Access your HMO ID at any time
See your healthcare activity and history

subsections.title: Stay Informed
points: Know when your plan is active
Get notified about changes, approvals, or updates
Understand your coverage before you need it

subsections.title: Flexibility That Fits Your Life
points: Choose plans that suit your needs
Upgrade or change plans when available
Access care without being tied to one location

subsections.title: Peace of Mind
points: Your data is securely stored and protected
Your healthcare records are always available
You are supported every step of the way

sections.heading: Our Promise to You
sections.closing: Your health matters, and with Woot Health, you are always in control.

sections.heading: Need Help
sections.content: If you have questions or need support, our team is always ready to help.
actions: Visit a partner hospital near you
